name: video_extract_audio
description: Extract the audio track of a completed video creation as MP3 (free, no AI). Returns a new queued audio creation; the source video is untouched.

creationIdentifier.description: Completed video creation to extract the audio track from.

folderReference.description: From `folders_list`. Omit → the user's Personal project (refused if `disabled`). Does NOT persist: once the user names a target, pass it on EVERY later generation/edit call.
